The same searcher, UAV-2503, detected her at step 333 in dq1 and at step 180 in dq0. In both arms the detection happens on the first step any UAV comes within Chebyshev 6 of her. At step 333 J filled her with ff_unit_0, the same pair the legacy counterfactual would pick (d* 46, against 48 for ff_unit_1). At step 360 ff_unit_0 is at (34,38), still 19 cells away.

- In dq1 those fuel writes never happened there. ff_unit_1 instead cleared around (19-26, 18-26) from step 100, and ff_unit_0 was out on the south-east leg.
- No unit wrote fuel in either arm before step 100, so the fire was identical until then. After that it diverged: belief at step 106, UAV-2503's distance to the true fire at step 120 (5 against 7), and 6 against 9 at step 136.
